_comment: English locale for SpellingBee. Keys (left) are fixed; translate only the values (right). Keep every {placeholder} verbatim, and keep the bracket example '[example]' and the allowed-letters display neutral (they are literal game syntax).

_slots.{allowed_letters}: The set of allowed letters, sorted and joined (do not translate)

prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in the Spelling Bee Game.
Allowed Letters: {allowed_letters}
Each word must be at least as long as the previous word.
Repeated words are not allowed.
Wrap your word in square brackets, e.g., '[example]'.

invalid.shorter: The submitted word is shorter than the previous word.
invalid.repeated: The submitted word has been submitted before.
invalid.not_a_word: The submitted word is not a valid english word.
invalid.illegal_characters: The submitted word contains illegal characters.
invalid.wrong_format: The submitted word does not follow the proper format. Please make sure to use squared brackets.
